scope: Add direct plain writeRawDxfObject() allocation rollback/retry/readback coverage to the seven-revision XRECORD string-only and combined string/Int32 override matrix.

source.profile: One raw XRECORD with five string groups (1, 3, 2, 6, 300) and two Int32 groups (90, 91); three routes emit unchanged fields, string overrides, or string plus Int32 overrides.

checks: Every measured allocation failure refuses output and preserves the prior destination
All caller raw XRECORD fields remain unchanged after failure and successful retry
Same-codec retry reproduces the clean bytes for each route, revision, and encoding
Fresh typed readback confirms unchanged values for the plain route and exact replacement values for both override routes

limitations: Generated codec transaction evidence only; no producer prevalence, application semantics, or broader support claim is established.
Other raw object types and writer overloads remain outside this profile.
No DWG/DXF fixture file was added; outputs are generated under temporary storage.
